title: limodorum pallidum
intro: Limodorum pallidum, commonly known as the pale adder's tongue orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the orchid family (Orchidaceae). The pale adder's tongue orchid has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant effects. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Limodorum pallidum for medicinal purposes.
